label: Radicalized Seitō beyond maternalist reform toward anarcho-feminist abolition
description: After taking over Seitō, Noe Itō increasingly challenged Hiratsuka's institutional maternalist campaigns, arguing with Emma Goldman and Sakae Ōsugi that state protection merely legitimizes authoritarian family and state control.
dialecticalTension: Contrasts state-mediated feminist reform with anti-statist free association.
